subject: Ink timing & onboarding countdown — final signoff and start date
messages:
From: Samuel Nguyen <samuel.nguyen@novaretail.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & SOW — timing question before sign

Hi Priya / Rishi —

Thanks for walking through the mutual action plan and the SOW earlier. The team reviewed MAP_NovaRetail_v5.pdf (attached) and we're comfortable with the scope. Before we push signature, two items to confirm on our side:

- Final start date: our ops team needs a confirmed start date so we can coordinate merchandising and SSO testing windows. We had tentatively penciled in June 14 but need confirmation.
- Signature timing: can your legal/finance commit to a 48-hour DocuSign window next week? We prefer signatures between June 2–4 to hit our internal launch gating.

If you can confirm those, I'll route to our procurement and get the sign-off.

Attachments: MAP_NovaRetail_v5.pdf (redline), project_timeline.xlsx (stub)

Thanks —
Samuel Nguyen
Head of Partnerships, NovaRetail
samuel.nguyen@novaretail.com
+1 415-555-0182
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samuel Nguyen <samuel.nguyen@novaretail.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & SOW — timing question before sign

Samuel — great, thanks for the quick read. Short answers and proposed plan:

1) Start date: we can commit to June 14 as the GA start. That gives our onboarding and E2E verification team two full weeks to run SSO/SCIM tests after signature.
2) Signature window: legal has approved the final SOW language; finance can be ready for signatures during Jun 2–4. We'll send DocuSign on the morning of June 2 PT to allow timezone coverage.

Proposed next steps (MAP items):
- Jun 2: Send DocuSign envelope (Redwood Ops + NovaRetail legal)
- Jun 3: Target signatures complete by EOD (we'll monitor in real time)
- Jun 4–11: Ops & NovaRetail run SSO/SCIM tests and onboarding playbook; remediate any issues
- Jun 14: Official sandbox->prod flip and launch window

I attached the exec-ready SOW draft (SOW_NovaRetail_exec-draft.pdf). If procurement needs any additional fields (billing PO/Ship-to), flag them and we'll accommodate in the DocuSign fields.

If that works, I'll loop in our Finance ops lead and kick the DocuSign on June 2.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-23T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP & SOW — timing question before sign (internal)

Priya / Marissa — forwarding Samuel's note and Priya's plan. Quick internal check: can we confirm two items before we release the envelope on Jun 2?

- Canary rollout: Ops requests approval to do a staged rollout (10% traffic first 24 hours) in case we see unexpected tokenization/regression issues tied to NovaRetail's longer prompt sequences. This is already in the MAP but needs explicit sign-off from product.
- Exec approval for the concession on API rate limit bursting during week 1 (we agreed to a temporary burst allowance). Need a single-line approval from VP to include in the DocuSign comments.

If both are green, I'll attach the final internal approval note to the envelope. Otherwise, please advise — I'm fine to wait 24 hours before sending the DocuSign.

Subject: Re: MAP & SOW — timing question before sign

Thanks — this all looks good. Confirming our side:

- We will sign the DocuSign envelope on Jun 3 (Aisha will own routing). Please send the envelope Jun 2 as proposed.
- NovaRetail approves the canary 10% first 24 hours with rollback criteria documented in the MAP (we've reviewed the metrics).
- We accept the temporary burst allowance during week 1; our infra lead will monitor.

Please include the following in the DocuSign comments so procurement doesn't block: PO field (PO-76842), billing address (NovaRetail HQ), and our contact for onboarding (aisha.patel@novaretail.com).

Once signed I'll send a scanned stub of the signed SOW back for your records (SOW_NovaRetail_signed_stub.pdf). Looking forward to the kickoff.

Samuel
